title: Demandbase One Platform Overview and Capabilities
content: Demandbase One is an integrated platform designed to automate signal intelligence and optimize go-to-market (GTM) outcomes throughout the entire customer journey. The platform unifies data, automates marketing, sales, and advertising execution, and connects various GTM tools with shared insights and workflows. It is engineered to automate growth across marketing, sales, advertising, and data teams within an organization. Demandbase One emphasizes a seamless experience for marketing teams to identify and engage top accounts using AI-driven account intelligence, helping personalize web journeys and convert more revenue. For sales teams, it surfaces in-market accounts, maps buying groups, and automates outreach to accelerate closing deals. On the advertising side, it leverages proprietary intent data combined with a B2B-native demand-side platform (DSP) to enable smart campaigns aimed at driving pipeline rather than just clicks. The data capabilities allow combining first-party and third-party data with transparent AI to generate trusted insights for meaningful outcomes. The platform has ongoing investment toward future innovations such as Agentbase, an AI agent-powered solution for account-based growth. Demandbase prides itself on owning its data rather than scraping, claiming unparalleled B2B coverage and laser-focused accuracy supporting precision targeting and engagement that drives conversions. The platform is elastic and scalable for enterprise needs and supports multiple use cases from a single unified platform. Customers consistently rate Demandbase highly, with recognition such as Vendr Verified placing it among the top 1% of SaaS offerings evaluated on quality, demand, pricing fairness, and speed of transactions. Additional strengths include its flexibility and transparency allowing customization to business needs, being the only demand-side platform built natively for B2B advertising, and its enterprise-grade security and support infrastructure.

title: Demandbase One™ for Marketing - Account-Based Experience
content: Demandbase One for Marketing delivers an account-based experience (ABX) designed to help teams identify, engage, and convert high-value accounts throughout the buyer journey. It provides a 360-degree view of every account, enabling marketers to understand which accounts to target, the optimal timing for outreach, and the relevant messaging to drive pipeline and revenue growth. The solution uses AI to prioritize accounts by combining intent signals and multiple data sources (first-, second-, and third-party) into a unified view. Key AI-driven capabilities include Qualification Score powered by predictive analytics that scores accounts by ideal customer profile (ICP) fit, Pipeline Predict which spots in-market opportunities based on historical deal data, and audience segmentation by role, stage, behaviors, engagement, and CRM fields. For engagement, it identifies real decision-makers including entire buying groups leveraging AI agents that map roles, with access to data on over 150 million professionals and 99 million companies. Automated, signal-driven outreach across ads, email, web channels, and sales engagement enhances conversion. For conversion, AI orchestrates multi-channel marketing plays and personalized web experiences aligned with account buying stage and behavior. It also integrates deeply with the tech stack enabling triggered plays. On the sales side, Demandbase shares unified data so sales reps are alerted in real-time about in-market accounts, with next-best actions guided by AI insights, buying group visibility, corporate family tree mapping, and enriched contact profiles to increase win rates. Case study results include 40% pipeline growth, 121% increase in in-market accounts, and doubling the number of marketing qualified accounts (MQAs) for customers.

title: Demandbase Sales Intelligence Product
content: The Demandbase Sales Intelligence offering focuses on helping sales teams identify and engage the real decision-makers within target accounts. It surfaces in-market accounts and maps detailed buying groups by using AI-powered agents that identify every role within the account’s buying team and analyze their behavior signals. The sales intelligence solution provides enriched contact data across 150 million professionals and 99 million companies to empower prospecting and outreach. It automates outreach based on real-time buyer intent signals to focus efforts on prospects currently showing interest. The platform also offers corporate family tree views to reveal relationships and cross-sell opportunities, along with syncing enriched contacts and buying group insights to support targeted sales conversations. By sharing a unified account view with marketing, sales is alerted about engagement activity and given clear guidance on next-best actions to close deals faster.

title: Demandbase Advertising Platform with B2B-Native Demand-Side Platform (DSP)
content: Demandbase Advertising platform combines proprietary buyer intent data with a B2B-native demand-side platform (DSP) that is uniquely engineered to serve business audiences, unlike generic consumer-focused systems. The platform enables marketers to run highly targeted campaigns that reach the right people at the right time in the buyer journey, focusing on pipeline generation instead of just clicks or impressions. By leveraging intent data integrated with the DSP, campaigns are optimized for qualified lead conversion and pipeline acceleration. Advertisers can improve ROI by targeting companies actively showing buying signals, personalizing messaging based on behavior, and aligning advertising efforts tightly with sales and marketing actions. The platform claims to be the best B2B ad tech available, addressing the nuances of business buying versus consumer models.

title: Demandbase Data Solutions and Account Intelligence
content: Demandbase’s data solutions combine carefully curated first-party and third-party data with advanced, transparent AI models to deliver unmatched B2B insights. The company owns its data rather than scraping it, which they claim ensures superior accuracy and coverage across business accounts. This foundation enables precision targeting, accurate intent detection, and more effective engagement that converts into revenue. The platform supports unifying various data sources to provide a complete account view consisting of company firmographics, intent signals, buying group behavior, and engagement metrics. Features include AI-driven intent scoring, account qualification scoring, and real-time account prioritization. Demandbase offers a free Account ID website visitor tracking tool edition for small to mid-size companies which identifies up to 25,000 unique monthly visitors by matching IP addresses and cookies to company profiles with best-in-class match rates. The identification data that is appended to website visits includes company, website, industry, segment, company size, revenue range, and headquarters location which integrates with Google Analytics for actionable insights.

title: Agentbase – The Future of Account-Based AI
content: Agentbase represents Demandbase’s vision and product innovation for the future of account-based marketing and sales powered by AI agents. These AI agents are designed to automate complex tasks in marketing and sales workflows by analyzing data signals and buyer behaviors to identify entire buying groups and individual decision-makers within target accounts. AI agents enhance account intelligence accuracy, personalize engagement, and enable orchestration of multi-channel campaigns with minimal manual input. They provide real-time insights to trigger relevant sales and marketing actions, optimize resource allocation, and grow pipeline velocity. Agentbase’s capabilities include identifying all roles in a buying group, predicting account readiness, and integrating with Demandbase’s broader GTM platform ecosystem. This innovation aims to unleash the full potential of account-based execution with AI-driven automation and insights.

title: Demandbase Integrations Marketplace and Ecosystem
content: Demandbase offers a comprehensive integrations marketplace that enables customers to unify their go-to-market (GTM) technology stack. The marketplace supports seamless connections to CRMs, marketing automation platforms, data providers, advertising networks, and other essential GTM tools, allowing workflows and data to flow smoothly across systems. This connected ecosystem helps organizations synchronize data, automate processes, and trigger complex plays that boost efficiency and effectiveness across marketing, sales, and advertising teams. Demandbase supports sandbox environments for integration testing and ensures enterprise-grade security and compliance when connecting external tools to the platform.

title: Customer Success Stories Demonstrating Demandbase Impact
content: Demandbase showcases multiple customer case studies illustrating measurable successes achieved using their platform. Examples include: - Coalfire achieving 40% pipeline growth leveraging ABX - Workforce Software seeing a 121% increase in in-market accounts and a 24% uplift in pipeline momentum after shifting from hunch-based marketing - Thales doubling marketing qualified accounts (MQAs), quadrupling click-through rates, and re-engaging 50% of targets - CyberArk realizing 4X higher close rates adopting an ABX approach powered by Demandbase - GoCardless unifying sales and marketing to deliver an 11X return on investment (ROI) - Denodo transforming its go-to-market approach through Demandbase ABX solutions These stories span industries including technology, corporate services, financial services, and illustrate benefits such as improved pipeline generation, sales and marketing alignment, increased conversion rates, and data-driven go-to-market execution.

title: Demandbase Unique Differentiators: Flexible, Transparent, and Enterprise-Ready ABM Platform
content: Demandbase positions itself as a flexible and transparent ABM platform prioritizing customer adaptability over rigid, black-box models. Customers can create custom predictive models overnight without expensive projects, defining engagement types and keywords to tailor recommendations specific to their business needs. The platform provides explainable AI with visibility into how account scores are calculated and what engagement activities contribute to the predictive scores, enabling marketers to understand and refine account qualification. Journey stages can be fully customized to fit any business lifecycle, including multiple journeys per product or business unit, with clear insights into stage logic. Demandbase’s platform is elastic and scalable for complex enterprise environments, with features like configurable business units workspaces, enterprise-grade security, compliance, and sandbox environments for safe testing. Its advertising technology is unique in being the only DSP built especially for B2B marketing. Demandbase also emphasizes its role as a true partner, highlighting exceptional end-to-end service, customer support, and a low-pressure sales process. It holds high market rankings verified by customer reviews and industry analysts.

title: Demandbase One for Sales Overview
content:
Demandbase One for Sales is a sales intelligence solution designed to help sales teams remove guesswork by identifying who to engage, why they matter, and how to win deals effectively. It tracks all buyer signals including search intent, website visits, email opens, and job changes. The platform leverages AI to surface the best accounts and key decision makers, automate follow-ups, and keep CRM records updated to discover high-value opportunities and increase close rates.

Key capabilities include:
- Providing a ranked list of in-market accounts with AI-driven recommendations on when and how to engage.
- Ability to see when companies research the seller and engage with content.
- Filtering and narrowing account lists by region, product interest, or assigned sales representative.
- Sorting prospects by engagement level or their buying journey stage.
- AI-generated summaries of every account’s history before outreach.
- Mapping and visualizing the full buying group involved in the purchasing decision, including champions, influencers, blockers, and decision makers.
- Access to a vast database covering over 160 million professionals at more than 104 million companies.
- Tracking buyer priorities by summarizing top engagement and intent signals with AI, monitoring account activity across websites and campaigns, identifying popular pages and topics of interest.
- Detecting anonymous visitors and providing follow-up suggestions.
- Utilizing news, social, and business signals to optimally time outreach efforts.
- Seamless synchronization of buyer data across the sales technology stack, including automatic contact record updates, and triggering workflows in tools such as Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, and various CRMs.
- Scoring and sorting contacts by freshness, relevance, and reliability.
- Use of Demandbase's Corporate Family Tree to find decision makers and map corporate relationships.
- Automation of routine sales tasks such as enriching contact and account details, syncing updates, auto-logging activities like email opens, page visits, and meetings to save hours for sales teams.

Demonstrated customer impacts include:
- 2.3x higher average deal size (Case Study: Palo Alto Networks Buying Groups).
- 83% increase in pipeline velocity (Case Study: Ingram Micro).
- 600% increase in meetings booked (Case Study: Trevipay).

Relevant resources for deeper understanding include the playbooks "Research Accounts Using Signals" and "Identify Your Most Visited Web Pages", plus product pages on Buying Groups for Sales.

title: Buying Groups and Decision Maker Mapping
content:
Demandbase One for Sales features comprehensive Buying Groups functionality to reveal the full set of individuals involved in B2B purchasing decisions. Recognizing that deals are influenced by teams rather than single stakeholders, the platform allows users to:

- View complete buying groups including champions, influencers, blockers, and decision makers.
- Identify who within the buying group is actively engaging and who requires nurturing.
- Leverage AI-driven recommendations sourced from an extensive database covering over 160 million professionals across 104 million companies.

This feature facilitates building a more complete and accurate sales outreach strategy targeting all key influencers and decision makers.

Additional related features include managing recommended and confirmed buying group members, viewing top buying groups, and integrating recommended people and person-based intent.

Demandbase provides extensive documentation such as "Understanding Recommended and Confirmed Buying Group Members", "View Recommended Buying Group Members", "Manage Buying Group Members", and "Understanding Top Buying Groups" to support utilization of these capabilities.

title: AI-Powered Account and Buyer Insights
content:
To help sales teams understand and prioritize accounts effectively, Demandbase One for Sales employs AI summarization and intent tracking features:

- AI generates summaries of each account's engagement history before outreach to provide context and personalized insights.
- Top buyer priorities are uncovered by analyzing engagement and intent signals, such as website activity, campaign interactions, news, social, and business indicators.
- The system tracks which pages and topics within the site capture the most buyer interest to guide sales messaging.
- Anonymous visitor identification is supported, along with AI-generated suggestions for follow-ups.
- This intelligence supports timing outreach efforts to coincide with optimal sales readiness.

Guides and playbooks available to users include "Understanding the AI Account Summary" and "Identify Your Most Visited Web Pages" to enable effective use of these AI-driven insights.

title: Demandbase AdsIQ Account-Targeting Technology
content:
Demandbase’s AdsIQ is a proprietary account-targeting technology that enhances bidding strategies by evaluating both user-level and account-level buying intent in real time. This eliminates the need for manual bid management and allows ad spend to be dynamically directed where it can achieve the best impact:

- Bids are set based on high, medium, and low intent signals detected from user and account behaviors.
- Frequency and budget are automatically balanced across accounts to prevent overspending on any single mega-account, maximizing efficient use of budget.
- AdsIQ’s AI-driven approach enables advertisers to glean deeper insights and better return on ad spend compared to traditional adtech platforms that typically cannot bid based on intent.

AdsIQ is fundamental to Demandbase’s value proposition in converting ad impressions into revenue pipeline.

Source URL: https://www.demandbase.com/why-demandbase/only-b2b-dsp/

title: Demandbase Account-Based Digital Advertising Platform Overview
content:
Demandbase offers an account-based digital advertising platform purpose-built to win B2B deals by reaching and engaging the right people in the right accounts at the moment they are ready to buy, while minimizing wasted spend. The platform solves key B2B advertising challenges such as ineffective targeting based on job titles and recycled intent signals, disconnected channels (LinkedIn, Google, Meta, display) that operate in silos, lack of integration to prove ad spend impact beyond vanity metrics, and the burden on lean marketing teams needing AI-powered scale without increasing headcount.

Key capabilities include: 
- Precise targeting powered by Demandbase Account Intelligence that enables building audience segments using buying groups, intent data, and CRM signals.
- People-based targeting that directs spend toward decision-makers within accounts.
- Early detection of purchase intent prior to website visits, using trillions of behavioral signals.
- Automatic alignment of ad budget and creative to the right buyer journey stage, eliminating manual adjustments.

Channel orchestration enables running campaigns across display, retargeting, native, video, and connected-TV from a single platform. Audiences sync instantly to LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube, Bing, Adobe, and X (Twitter) with messaging coherence maintained across all channels. 

The AdsIQ technology powers account-targeting with real-time bid adjustments based on user and account intent, automatically balancing frequency to prevent budget drain by large accounts. 

Performance measurement focuses on real business impact by tracing ad impressions through pipeline stages to closed revenue. The platform provides granular insights into job levels and departments engaging with ads, including known contacts, and compares creative effectiveness at a glance.

Deployment is simple: connect existing data from various tools, define campaign parameters or use templates, launch omnichannel campaigns, let AI optimize targeting and bidding in real time based on intent signals and campaign settings, and leverage dashboards for ROI proof.

Brand safety is ensured by showing ads only on credible, buyer-trusted websites through screening.

Source URL: https://www.demandbase.com/product-tour/advertising/

title: Demandbase B2B Demand Side Platform (DSP) Features
content:
Demandbase B2B DSP is uniquely designed for the complexities of B2B buying processes characterized by long sales cycles, high stakes, and multi-person decisions. Unlike general consumer ad tech, this DSP is built from the ground up for B2B needs rather than retrofitted.

Core capabilities include:
- Account Intelligence: Identification of in-market accounts, awareness of which accounts are actively in a deal, and pinpointing decision influencers before competitors.
- Orchestrated Advertising: Ability to reach full buying groups across all channels without manual effort.
- Funnel-aware Activation: Combining real-time buyer intent data with funnel stage personalization to deliver smarter, stage-appropriate ads.
- Unified Go-To-Market Platform: Integration of marketing, sales, and advertising workflows allowing shared language and alignment.

Omnichannel reach spans LinkedIn, Meta, Google, Connected TV (CTV), and more, driven by trillions of monthly behavioral and intent signals to detect who is researching the category, which accounts signal rising intent, and key stakeholders within those accounts.

Smart budget management features:
- Account-level frequency capping to avoid overexposure and budget drain by single mega-accounts.
- AI-powered SmartBid technology optimizes bids according to account-level buying signals, ensuring spend efficiency.
- People-based targeting combined with account strategy ensures ads reach actual buyers, not just random clicks.

Simplified operations allow single campaigns to adapt dynamically across funnel stages using journey-aware targeting and dynamic creative rotation, removing the need for multiple campaign sets. Budget allocation is automatically adjusted in real-time as accounts progress in the buyer journey.

Reporting focuses on pipeline and revenue impact, moving beyond clicks and impressions by linking ad performance directly to CRM data for actionable insights on account and individual levels in real time.

Brand protection and personalized ad impressions ensure ads appear only on trusted sites with tailored messaging.

Source URL: https://www.demandbase.com/why-demandbase/only-b2b-dsp/

title: Demandbase B2B Advertising Campaign Workflow and AI Optimization
content:
Demandbase streamlines B2B advertising campaign execution through a structured workflow backed by AI:

1. Connect Data - Advertisers sync data from existing tools, import contact and account lists, or directly build audience segments leveraging Demandbase's intelligence layer.

2. Define the Play - Campaign parameters are set by choosing buyer journey stages, target audiences (accounts or people), preferred advertising channels, or starting from prebuilt templates.

3. Launch Everywhere - Demandbase orchestrates campaign audience activation across multiple channels including social media (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram), search (Google, Bing), display, video, and connected-TV (CTV).

4. AI Optimization - Artificial intelligence continuously adjusts targeting and bidding strategies in real time based on detected buyer intent signals and preconfigured settings to maximize efficiency and impact.

5. Prove Impact - Integrated dashboards allow users to trace ad impressions back to their influence on the sales pipeline and closed-won revenue, enabling data-driven campaign optimization.

This AI-powered automation provides scalability and effectiveness for lean marketing teams, reducing manual effort and enabling smarter budget allocation without increasing headcount.

title: Thales quadruples CTRs, doubles MQAs, and re-engages 50% of targets with Demandbase One ABX and Advertising
content: Thales Cloud Protection and Licensing, a leader in data protection headquartered in Paris, France, transformed its marketing and sales tech stack by implementing Demandbase One, focusing on ABX and advertising. The company moved from traditional lead-generation to account-based marketing (ABM), addressing deficiencies like lack of integrated data, intent and engagement insights beyond first-party data, and insufficient automation and scaling tools. Elsa Toutlemonde, Account-Based Marketing Manager EMEA, led this change, aiming for a single source of truth to enable better decision-making. By placing Demandbase One at the center of their ABM strategy, Thales drives account selection, monitors intent, automates targeted advertising campaigns, and integrates with Salesforce, Reachdesk for direct mail gifting, and a content experience platform for personalization scaling. Initial results include a 4x increase in click-through rates (industry average CTRs), doubling marketing qualified accounts (MQAs), and re-engaging 50% of previously disengaged target accounts. The team is still early in adoption but enthusiastic about further unlocking Demandbase's capabilities, particularly orchestration of audience segments into platforms like LinkedIn through dynamic lists that auto-refresh. Demandbase was selected partly due to prior usage in the Asia Pacific region and its ability to consolidate multiple needs (advertising, data, automation) into a single tool. The sales teams are progressively being onboarded to leverage this transformation. Elsa Toutlemonde highlighted the significant room for growth and the powerful baseline that Demandbase provides.

title: WIKA Mobile Control launches into new markets using Demandbase One insights
content: WIKA Mobile Control, an industrial company headquartered in Chambersburg, PA, with 250 employees, expanded their business beyond the crane market, which was saturated after 30 years. The company needed a way to reach new customers unfamiliar with their products effectively and generate pipeline cost-effectively. Marketing Manager Sarah Nell led the initiative, leveraging Demandbase One with ABX and advertising. WIKA Mobile Control benefited from Demandbase's high-touch support and onboarding due to their newness to ABM. Within the first four months, the team ran four targeted campaigns with personalized messaging and achieved remarkable results: reaching 90% of targeted accounts, 55% of those accounts clicked on ads, and 26% showed an increase in onsite engagement during campaigns. Sales and marketing alignment was emphasized by Sarah delivering personalized weekly reports to sales reps detailing engagement and campaign interactions by current and prospective customers. This collaboration contributed to sales reps entering meetings with higher contextual intelligence about client interest. Additionally, WIKA tracked attendee engagement before and after major trade shows to follow up timely with key accounts, demonstrating the platform's ability to optimize event-related marketing efforts. Though focusing on new clients, Demandbase also enabled WIKA to cross-sell within their existing customer base by identifying accounts interested in new offerings.

title: Ingram Micro and CloudBlue increase pipeline velocity by 83% using Demandbase One
content: Ingram Micro, a global tech and software distributor with over 10,001 employees based in Irvine, CA, along with its subsidiary CloudBlue—a SaaS platform specializing in subscription management and digital commerce—used Demandbase One with ABX and advertising to drastically improve pipeline velocity by 83%. They reduced their sales cycle from an average of 12 months to just 2 months. The CloudBlue team implemented a scoring model to define their ideal customer profile (ICP) and monitored different funnel stages cohesively within the Demandbase platform, enabling personalized customer journeys and relevant content delivery. Within just two months of launching their initial campaign, they identified accounts previously stagnating in the funnel and converted them into sales-qualified accounts. This approach also improved alignment between sales and marketing teams, facilitating streamlined multi-channel integrated campaigns launched within minutes. Demandbase allowed Ingram Micro and CloudBlue to combine multiple touchpoints effectively and achieve significant acceleration in funnel progression and pipeline contribution.

title: Coalfire transforms ABM strategy achieving 40% pipeline growth and 25% higher conversion rates with Demandbase
content: Coalfire, a global cybersecurity advisory services firm, faced challenges including inefficient account targeting, poor lead quality, and attribution complexity which hindered ROI visibility. By implementing Demandbase, Coalfire leveraged AI-driven account insights, predictive analytics, and integrated CRM and marketing automation data, consolidating account data from Salesforce and Marketo. This unified view enabled better audience segmentation, focusing on high-value accounts through real-time intent signals. Coalfire ran pilot campaigns to validate targeting precision and expanded adoption supported by Demandbase’s customer success team including training and certification. The strategy promoted stronger sales-marketing alignment and transition from generalized marketing to precision ABM strategies. The results included 40% growth in marketing-generated pipeline, a 25% increase in lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, and improved cross-team coordination and campaign attribution. Demandbase’s AI and platform integration capabilities were central to overcoming prior fragmentation and data silos.

title: WorkForce Software increases in-market account engagement by 121% and pipeline momentum by 24% using Demandbase One
content: WorkForce Software, a global provider of integrated employee experience and workforce management solutions with 750 employees and global operations, sought to transform its go-to-market approach from lead-based to account-based marketing under CMO Sandra Moran. The company had relied heavily on gated content and generic lead-flooding tactics that negatively impacted customer experience. Sandra emphasized creating a differentiated, educative engagement experience and targeted resource allocation on in-market companies. Prior to Demandbase, the company lacked accurate data on account readiness and journey stage. By leveraging Demandbase One (ABX, advertising, and sales intelligence), WorkForce Software achieved a 121% increase in in-market account engagement over six months and a 24% increase in pipeline momentum for those accounts. The platform helped better target customers, understand their stage in the buying process, and reach the correct decision-makers effectively. The shift allowed more personalized, coordinated campaigns aligned to actual purchase journey insights.

title: SAP Concur boosts revenue by 52%, deal size by 57%, and pipeline by 59% with Demandbase ABX and Advertising Cloud
content: SAP Concur, part of SAP and headquartered in Bellevue, WA with 10,000 employees, revamped its U.S. enterprise account-based marketing program under Senior Manager Ryan Oliver utilizing Demandbase ABX Cloud and Advertising Cloud. Ryan needed a platform to scale targeting for a large universe of accounts within a limited budget, emphasizing ABM best practices such as multi-touch campaigns, consolidated account insights, and comprehensive analytics. Demandbase consolidated disconnected data from Salesforce, Marketo, and Adobe Analytics, enriching it with intent signals to improve account intelligence. The platform empowered prioritization of accounts, segmentation into cohorts, and execution of personalized ad campaigns. Results included a 60% lift in web visits from advertised accounts versus prior periods, including nearly 500 previously inactive accounts. Engagement rates across seven campaign cohorts improved from 51% to 95%. Additionally, alignment across multi-layered marketing and sales organizations deepened, with shared insights and coordinated efforts fueling success. Demandbase also helped forecast upsell or cross-sell opportunities by detecting customers investigating competitive solutions through intent data. Ryan credits Demandbase for providing comprehensive capabilities for list prioritization, advertising, and analytics within a single platform, allowing him to justify continued investment through demonstrated impact.

title: Demandbase Company Overview and Growth Story
content: Demandbase was founded in 2006 to provide B2B marketers with better intelligence. From 2007 to 2015, it pioneered innovations in Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and intent data, radically reshaping how teams target and engage accounts. The 2016 acquisition of Spiderbook introduced automation to identify companies likely to buy, focusing on those already in-market. In 2020, the acquisition of Engagio redefined the B2B martech landscape and go-to-market strategies. The 2021 acquisition of InsideView and DemandMatrix created a comprehensive solution covering firmographics, technographics, intent data, account identification, and contacts. Between 2023 and 2024, Demandbase launched Pipeline AI to enable buying group intelligence and automate GTM (go-to-market) execution. Today, Demandbase positions itself as the only Pipeline AI platform connecting people, processes, and platforms for automated growth. The company serves more than 1,000 customers, employs over 750 team members, boasts a 367% average customer ROI, and maintains a 4.9-star customer support rating. Demandbase’s core values include being bold, moving fast, and winning together, emphasizing innovation, speed to impact, and collaborative success. The executive team is led by CEO Gabe Rogol, who is responsible for fulfilling the company’s mission to transform B2B go-to-market approaches.

title: Leadership Profile: Gabe Rogol, CEO of Demandbase
content: Gabriel Rogol serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Demandbase. In his role, Gabe Rogol is responsible for leading Demandbase in its mission to transform how B2B companies execute their go-to-market strategies. Specific responsibilities include overseeing company growth, innovation, strategic direction, and developing technologies that empower marketing and revenue teams with clarity and confidence to build predictable pipelines and enable meaningful growth.

title: Demandbase Corporate Values and Work Culture
content: Demandbase’s corporate values guide how the company builds, creates, and collaborates. Their key values are 1) Be Bold — challenging the status quo and envisioning better solutions to advance the industry, not just incremental changes; 2) Move Fast — anticipating, adapting, and learning quickly to deliver impactful results and turning ideas into actionable impact rapidly; 3) Win Together — fostering a team culture premised on honesty, leveraging diverse perspectives, and shared success so that collective victory leads to customer wins. These values power the company’s innovation and customer success approach.

title: Demandbase Careers and Employee Benefits Overview
content: Demandbase promotes a mission to transform how B2B companies go to market and actively recruits bold, curious talent to help lead this transformation. The company offers a range of benefits designed to nurture employee well-being and professional growth: Health and wellness plans cover medical, dental, vision, 401k, and mental/physical wellness programs including Modern Health, Headspace, and Zeel virtual stretch sessions. All employees are granted stock options, reinforcing a culture of shared success. Flexible time off alongside abundant paid holidays and two week-long company-wide breaks support work-life balance. Family-friendly benefits include parental leaves for birth, adoption, fostering, and broader family needs at all life stages. The hybrid work environment allows employees to work full-time, part-time, in-office, or fully remote depending on role and location. Demandbase cultivates an inclusive, transparent, and approachable culture fostering belonging, recognition, and continuous culture improvement. The company offers leadership training, regular development conversations, group coaching, and access to courses from Masterclass, Coursera, A Cloud Guru, Pavilion, plus reimbursement and dedicated learning days for professional development. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) actively support diversity and inclusion with groups for Black/African American (BIG), Hispanic/Latinx (DemandAFuerza), Women, Neurodiverse@DB, LGBTQ+ (DBQ), and Asian American Pacific Islander (AAPI Rise). These ERGs amplify member voices and contribute to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace.

title: Demandbase B2B Company Data Overview
content: Demandbase provides highly curated B2B company data designed to help sales and marketing teams overcome challenges with unverified or cluttered prospect data. Their AI-driven account identification technology is backed by over a decade of experience and billions of data signals, providing unmatched accuracy to unmask and reveal companies visiting clients’ websites. Demandbase’s data coverage includes over 104 million relevant and curated companies, more than 3.1 million corporate hierarchies, 750 industries, data from over 40,000 sources, and coverage spanning 195 countries worldwide. Detailed company data points offered include revenue, employee counts, industry and sub-industry classifications with deep profiles, headquarters and branch addresses with branch site counts, financial data and fiscal years, among dozens of other company attributes. Demandbase prioritizes streamlined, curated data by automatically removing duplicates, defunct or fictitious companies, and micro-businesses, reducing clutter so users can focus on valuable insights. The platform covers every public company globally and most private companies with five or more employees. Demandbase’s automated account hierarchies (family trees) enable smarter sales and marketing decisions by linking parent and subsidiary companies. This facilitates assignment of accounts to appropriate reps avoiding conflicts, uncovering cross-sell opportunities, providing warm introductions across related accounts, and expanding footprints through enterprise or master services agreements. Their validation process uses multi-source triangulation combined with AI and machine learning to continuously refine data accuracy. Human experts monitor and benchmark data quality and feed improvements into machine learning models. Customers can flag inaccurate data easily via a “wrong info” mechanism, supporting continuous enhancement of the data set.

title: Demandbase Privacy Notice Summary
content: Effective December 19, 2025, Demandbase’s Privacy Notice governs the collection, use, disclosure, and protection of personal information in relation to Demandbase services, websites, virtual or physical events, and other interactions with Demandbase and its subsidiaries including Demandbase Limited and Demandbase India Private Limited. Personal information includes any data about an identified or identifiable natural person. Depending on context, Demandbase processes personal information under various legal bases such as compliance with law, protection of interests, or legitimate business interests like service provision, security, and direct marketing, provided these interests do not override individual fundamental rights. The privacy notice excludes application to websites or services owned by Demandbase’s customers, partners, or ad publishers. Personal information collected may include name, contact details, job-related information, and content posted in community forums or social media. Collection also occurs indirectly via device or browser data such as IP address, device identifiers, geographic location, email open behaviors, authentication, and analytics data, enabling a more personalized user experience. Demandbase may receive personal data from other sources, including its customers. Data collection and sharing are governed by specific policies detailed further in the notice.

content: Demandbase provides extensive support documentation covering privacy, security, and legal compliance. Key available resources include: - CVE-2021-44228 Log4j Vulnerability guidance for addressing this critical security issue - March 2019 Security Update notes detailing past security improvements - Customer Security Incident Reporting Policy outlining procedures for clients to report incidents - Customer Security Responsibility guidance on security practices expected from customers - DAA & EDAA Opt-Out Notice explaining data advertising opt-out mechanisms - Data Processing Agreement detailing legal terms governing data handling - Data Subject Requests instructions for individual rights regarding their personal data - Demandbase Master Cloud Agreement specifying terms, conditions, and use restrictions - Demandbase Sub-Processor List listing third-party processors engaged by Demandbase - Data Impact summaries relating to data security and privacy - Demandbase Privacy Notice and Security Policy documentation - Terms of Use for Demandbase services - Demandbase Data Solution Additional Terms clarifying further legal provisions These resources provide transparency and instructions addressing both customers and individuals to foster trust and compliance with data privacy and security standards.

title: Demandbase Personalization: Website Personalization Tools to Increase Conversion Rates
content:
Demandbase Personalization enables marketers to tailor website experiences by identifying visitors through Account Intelligence data, such as industry, company size, buying journey stage, and technographics. This allows creation of customized web pages with tailored images, copy, CTA buttons, and links that deliver relevant messages based on account attributes, intent signals, and buyer journey stage. The solution aims to increase conversion rates by serving only pertinent content to visitors, enhancing engagement and customer experience.

Forms Enrichment is a feature within personalization designed to reduce form friction by keeping forms short and automatically filling many fields on the backend, such as company name, industry, company size, and other B2B attributes. This improves form completion rates, reduces user errors, and ensures detailed information flows into connected marketing automation platforms and CRM.

The platform offers an easy-to-use interface which allows real-time editing and previewing of changes including images, CTAs, and copy, saving time on review cycles. Users can prioritize website experiences for accounts qualifying for multiple experiences, and test different form designs with version history and rollback capabilities.

The personalization solution integrates with Demandbase’s B2B contact database and account-based analytics, bringing AI-curated contact and lead data, enabling marketers to find and engage decision-makers effectively.

Key features:
- Visitor identification via AccountID using firmographic and technographic data
- Customizable web content (images, copy, CTAs)
- Personalization based on account attributes and intent
- Forms enrichment with automatic backend data population
- Easy self-service UI for real-time changes and previews
- Form testing and history
- Integration with marketing automation and CRM

title: Demandbase One™ for Marketing: AI-Powered ABX Platform to Identify, Engage, and Convert Accounts
content:
Demandbase One™ for Marketing is an ABX (Account-Based Experience) platform designed to help marketing and sales teams identify, engage, and convert the right accounts throughout the buyer journey. The platform provides a 360-degree view of every account across stages, with AI and intent data guiding timing, messaging, and engagement.

Key capabilities include:
- AI-powered account prioritization combining first-, second-, and third-party data
- Qualification Score to rate accounts by Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) fit
- Pipeline Predict identifies in-market opportunities based on historical deal patterns
- Segmentation by role, buyer journey stage, behavior, CRM fields, and engagement
- AI Agents identify and map entire buying groups within target accounts, clarifying roles and behaviors
- Access to contact data on over 150 million professionals and 99 million companies
- Automated campaigns across channels including ads, email, websites, and sales platforms
- Opt-in contact verification and adjustment to refine AI-based recommendations

Customer results include:
- 40% pipeline growth (example: Coalfire case study)
- 121% increase in in-market accounts (example: Workforce Software case study)

title: Orchestration Automations in Demandbase
content: Demandbase offers 'Orchestration Automations' which allow customers to create complex workflows and automations triggered by account and prospect activity. Support articles explain core concepts such as overall orchestration, creation of automations, adding choices to automation actions, how to preview and schedule automations, and setting qualification rules to determine when automations fire. Additional resources detail activating and managing automations, understanding the overview table of automations, viewing automation history, and descriptions of various specific automation actions including integration with Gong engage flows, HubSpot workflows, Marketo campaigns, Outreach sequences, Salesloft cadences, LeanData routing, adding account lists to integration, and changing CRM account and person data. These automations enable marketers and sales teams to deliver timely, targeted engagement and data updates automatically.

title: Demandbase Orchestration: Account-Based Go-To-Market Automation and Sales-Marketing Alignment
content:
Demandbase Orchestration is a sales and marketing orchestration platform enabling scalable execution of account-based go-to-market (GTM) plays. It unifies sales and marketing activities to automate personalized, account-centric customer journeys with high precision.

Features:
- Unlimited automations: Build account- or people-based automated workflows integrating multiple Martech and RevTech tools including Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, Salesforce, Outreach, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, Bing, Adobe, YouTube, PFL (print & mail), and Sendoso.
- Scheduling automations with trigger conditions or continuous dynamic/static audience lists.
- Precise segmentation using Selectors to create audiences based on buyer persona, journey stage, behavior, intent, sales activity, ICP fit, and more.
- Push audiences to third-party platforms for ads, sales engagement, or marketing automation.
- Cross-channel play automation allows triggering plays in CRM, marketing automation, advertising platforms, website personalization, direct mail, and more.
- Customer data management automates data cleaning, normalization, status field updates, and engagement scoring to streamline workflows and optimize performance measurement.
- Cross-sell plays detect product-specific demand signals and trigger relevant marketing and sales follow-up actions to grow customer lifetime value.

Demandbase Orchestration is unique in enabling combined people and account-based plays from one centralized platform, aligning cross-channel engagement to act on insights quickly and at scale.

title: Marketing Integrations Overview in Demandbase One
content: The Demandbase One platform for marketing offers various integration functionalities to enhance marketing operations. Key articles include an overview of marketing integrations, a comprehensive reference list for Demandbase One for Marketing integrations, steps to re-authenticate integrations when needed, and an explanation of the Demandbase Marketplace where integrations can be browsed and accessed. These resources help marketers connect Demandbase to other marketing tools for activities like data synchronization, campaign management, and lead nurturing.

title: Salesforce CRM Integration Setup Steps with Demandbase
content: The Salesforce CRM integration with Demandbase involves multiple setup steps covered in detailed support articles. These include adding the Demandbase App Package in Salesforce, obtaining Salesforce credentials needed for authentication, adding the Salesforce integration within the Demandbase platform, mapping and adding Demandbase custom fields to Salesforce, and embedding the Demandbase One for Sales iFrame in Salesforce to visualize Demandbase sales intelligence directly within the CRM. The complete integration setup enables streamlined data sync and enhanced sales workflow via combined CRM and Demandbase insights.

title: HubSpot CRM Integration with Demandbase
content: Demandbase integrates with HubSpot CRM through defined processes and best practices. Important documentation covers an overview of the integration, best practices for managing HubSpot CRM permissions to ensure proper access and security, detailed steps to integrate HubSpot CRM data with Demandbase for sales activities, re-authentication procedures for maintaining connectivity, the definition and use of Demandbase custom fields within HubSpot CRM, and mapping of HubSpot CRM fields to Demandbase. This integration facilitates unified account intelligence and sales functions across both platforms.

title: Microsoft Dynamics CRM Integration with Demandbase
content: The integration between Demandbase and Microsoft Dynamics CRM consists of a multi-step OAuth-based setup process. Key steps include creating the Demandbase app within Microsoft Dynamics, creating an integration user with appropriate privileges, and adding the Microsoft Dynamics integration in Demandbase either via OAuth or using a pre-configured Demandbase app. Additional configuration involves adding the Demandbase App Package in Microsoft Dynamics, defining lead source parameters for leads, and embedding the Demandbase One for Sales iFrame within Microsoft Dynamics UI to provide sales teams with account intelligence inside their CRM interface. Other key topics are custom field mapping, setting permissions for list views, removing the app package, and mapping Microsoft Dynamics data fields to Demandbase standards.

title: Sales Integrations - Demandbase Agentforce Prospecting Agent for Salesforce
content: Demandbase provides a Sales integration called the Agentforce Prospecting Agent specifically for Salesforce users. Documentation includes an overview article describing its capabilities and a detailed installation guide for deploying the Demandbase Agentforce Prospecting Agent within Salesforce CRM. This integration helps sales professionals by embedding Demandbase prospecting tools directly into their Salesforce environment, streamlining prospecting workflows and improving efficiency in identifying and managing sales opportunities.

title: Integrated Systems Setup and Management
content: Demandbase supports the setup and management of various third-party integrations through a robust integrated systems framework. Key guides cover setting up third-party integrations by configuring connection and sync parameters, understanding data sync settings that control how data flows between Demandbase and external systems, managing action visibility and access through action configuration controls (which influence which users see and can execute integration actions), and creating or managing custom actions within the Demandbase platform to tailor integrations to specific business needs. Additional information details how to create and manage custom integrations for use cases not covered by standard connectors, enabling flexible extension of Demandbase functionality.

title: B2B Account Intelligence: Combining Your Data with Demandbase’s AI-Powered Insights
content: Demandbase One™ for Marketing and Sales offers advanced B2B Account Intelligence by fusing a company's own first-party data with Demandbase's extensive third-party B2B data sources and AI technologies. It enables GTM teams to uncover in-market opportunities and confidently engage buyers by interpreting the chaotic and often hidden B2B buyer journey signals. Demandbase cleans and consolidates fragmented first-party data trapped in CRMs, emails, marketing systems, and chats, blending it with ethically sourced third-party data to provide a comprehensive 360° view of target accounts. Its predictive models generate actionable insights to help teams prioritize the best account opportunities, engage smarter, and accelerate deal closure. The platform delivers key capabilities such as lead-to-account mapping to reduce wasted effort, advanced selectors for building and activating highly targeted segments, precise predictive models to identify accounts likely to buy, buyer journey stage mapping for tailored messaging, engagement heatmaps to focus resources on hot prospects, and automated data cleansing and enrichment to maintain data accuracy. Demandbase is recognized as one of the world’s most reliable third-party B2B data providers, sourcing data from over 40,000 providers with machine learning, AI, and human validation to ensure exceptional data accuracy and confidence. Users can explore further features including access to information on 100 million companies encompassing detailed firmographics (industry, revenue, employee count, location, financials, account hierarchies, and more).

title: Demandbase Predictive Analytics: AI-Driven Scoring to Drive Predictable Revenue
content: Demandbase’s B2B predictive analytics software uses AI and the Demandbase account intelligence foundation to enable revenue teams to create easy-to-setup predictive scoring models for prioritizing accounts and opportunities. It enables scoring based on company fit, high intent actions, buyer journey stage, and engagement across multiple channels such as website, email, inbox, CRM, and marketing automation systems. The platform automates extraction of predictive insights without requiring manual intervention or specialized data science skills, allowing users to build and deploy predictive models rapidly. Multiple predictive models can be created for different products, services, or business units to avoid cross-contamination of behavioral patterns. Key features include a Pipeline Predict Score that prioritizes accounts likely to become sales opportunities by analyzing past opportunities and activity patterns, customizable training using user-defined opportunity definitions and keywords, and selection of engagement activities that matter for scoring refinement. Additionally, it offers qualification scoring aligned to Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP) to identify attributes predictive of best customers and uncover qualified accounts beyond existing targets. For advertising, Demandbase integrates automated AI Smart Bidding where individual campaign predictive models manage bid/no-bid decisions on each impression, and the DSP optimizes pacing and impression distribution for balanced account influence. This facilitates a more hands-off approach with better campaign outcomes.

title: Demandbase B2B Data Cloud: Comprehensive AI-Powered B2B Data for Account Growth
content: Demandbase offers an AI-powered data cloud platform fueling go-to-market success through comprehensive, clean, and accurate B2B data integration. The platform harnesses intent signals, technographics, firmographics, contact data, and millions of other data points to identify, prioritize, and engage the highest-potential accounts with precision timing. It leverages Account Intelligence to provide a unified data source encompassing account identification (turning anonymous website visitors into known accounts via over a trillion monthly signals), company information sourced from 40,000+ providers, verified B2B contact data revealing buying teams, global intent data spotting early in-market accounts, and detailed technographics covering 34,000+ technologies and platforms. Demandbase emphasizes transforming incomplete or outdated data into actionable intelligence through AI-driven data cleansing and enrichment, ensuring GTM strategies rely on reliable, current information. The platform offers REST-based APIs enabling easy integration of Demandbase account intelligence into customer applications, accelerating opportunity identification and intelligent engagement. With endorsement from multiple sources and a global data reach, Demandbase Data Cloud positions itself as a pivotal engine for data-driven business growth.

title: Demandbase Account Identification: AI-Powered Reveal of Anonymous Website Visitors
content: Demandbase Account Identification solution uses advanced AI and machine learning developed over more than a decade to unmask anonymous companies visiting client websites. Powered by behavioral modeling, real-time signal processing, traffic volume/time patterns, and a proprietary vast IP and cookie dataset, the system delivers unparalleled accuracy and match rates unmatched by reliance on IP registries or reverse DNS data. Key data statistics include classification of over 3.7 billion IP addresses, 2.9 billion active cookies & IDs, and synchronization across 176+ million validated contacts. The platform maintains high accuracy through extensive bot detection using web crawlers and validators, refusing to compromise accuracy for inflated match rates. By revealing website visitor identities, marketers and sales teams can elevate web analytics, optimize visitor acquisition strategies, and uncover new sales and up-sell opportunities. Demandbase offers a free trial of the tool, underscoring its confidence in delivering results. This solution plays a key role in Demandbase’s broader AI-powered account intelligence ecosystem, integrating with the company information database containing 100 million companies detailing firmographics, financials, and account hierarchies.

title: Demandbase B2B Contact Data: AI-Curated Database to Connect with Decision Makers
content: Demandbase's B2B contact data provides access to over 176 million AI-curated contacts spanning 195 countries, incorporating more than 109 million validated emails and 54 million direct dials. Designed to help sales and marketing teams avoid chasing irrelevant or outdated contacts, this solution emphasizes connecting with decision-makers and influencers to build comprehensive buying groups. The contact database enables users to search contacts by job title, seniority, function, location, and connections, focusing specifically on key decision-maker roles. Additional features include a browser extension for data access throughout the web, seamless CRM integration for effortless data syncing, and tools to identify corporate connections facilitating warm introductions. Demandbase reduces spam risk by verifying email addresses every 30 days, and helps craft personalized messages enriched by company news and intent data. Data cleanliness is maintained through multi-source AI and machine learning validation, combined with a user flagging system that triggers human verification and record updates typically within 48 hours. The contact database is a core element of Demandbase’s AI-powered account intelligence, complementing firmographic and technographic data for full account insight.

title: Demandbase B2B Technographic Data: Insights on Customer Technology Usage for Targeting
content: Demandbase’s B2B technographic data helps sales and marketing teams identify and target ideal accounts based on the hardware and software technologies they use and plan to purchase. Covering both front-end and back-end technologies, it incorporates data from over 136 million domains and tracks more than 47,000 technologies, refreshed regularly to ensure accuracy and relevance. Unlike competitors focusing mainly on easily detected front-end tech, Demandbase also mines for technologies behind firewalls using AI, multiple data signals, and a large database to provide unmatched depth. Additional tailored insights include next technology purchases, IT spending, and estimated revenue potential. These insights enable improved targeting of prospects, ad campaigns, prioritization of sales efforts, relevance in communication, accurate forecasting, and reduced wasted effort on dead-end leads. Statistical benefits from clients include up to 3x higher demand generation response rates, 78% more cost-effective spend, 51% higher likelihood of successful sales contacts, and 57% faster time to close. Recognized by Microsoft’s Go-To-Market Lead Makoto Ishizaka as essential for becoming trusted advisors, Demandbase technographics can be accessed seamlessly across Demandbase One™ products for segment building, account qualification, and sales strategy optimization.

title: Demandbase B2B Buyer Intent Data: Early Detection of In-Market Accounts Globally
content: Demandbase provides global B2B buyer intent data that allows sales and marketing teams to identify accounts showing purchase interest well before direct engagement occurs. The intent data sources include direct access to the bidstream plus proprietary technology to uncover unknown accounts, coupled with AI and natural language processing (NLP) to enhance signal relevance by deciphering context and minimizing noisy or irrelevant activity. The platform supports 133 languages including multi-byte non-Latin character sets, enabling broad international intent tracking. Users can create unlimited keyword sets tailored to their products and competitors, with views on historical intent, intent trends over time, intent strength, and keyword quality. Demandbase analyzes over 2 trillion monthly intent signals from more than 70 billion daily page views, using AI/ML to reduce false positives and improve signal accuracy. The platform also partners with other intent data providers such as Bombora Surge®, G2, and TrustRadius to import additional intent signals, ensuring comprehensive coverage. Demandbase intent data helps trigger targeted campaigns, personalize messaging, avoid customer churn, and expand accounts by revealing accounts in-market for the client’s products at all stages of the buying journey.

title: Demandbase Smarter Account Intelligence: Data Quality, Coverage, and AI for Enhanced Targeting
content: Demandbase emphasizes data quality over quantity, delivering comprehensive coverage and exceptional accuracy to enhance B2B targeting capabilities. Their Account Intelligence, fueling Demandbase One™, utilizes more than one trillion monthly account identification signals processed via AI to deliver the industry's most accurate account identification. Data sources exceed 40,000 news, financial, and social providers, including trusted vendors like Refinitiv and Equifax, with multi-source triangulation ensuring unmatched precision. Users also benefit from a robust editorial process allowing flags on inaccurate data, which editorial teams verify and update typically within 48 hours. Demandbase uncovers buyer intent by analyzing over one trillion monthly intent signals, applying AI and ML to distinguish relevant signals from noise. This intelligence drives personalization, predictive scoring, journey stage understanding, and campaign automation across marketing and sales functions. The platform’s integration of behavioral patterns, firmographics, contact data, and intent signals creates a reliable foundation for marketing and sales teams to deliver relevant experiences to the right accounts and individuals throughout the buyer journey.

title: Demandbase Support Articles and Resources for Data & Analytics
content: Demandbase provides a range of support resources within the Data & Analytics category, including FAQ sections on Account Identification, comprehensive API documentation, and developer resources. Key support articles include 'FAQs: Account Identification,' which answers common questions about identifying anonymous web visitors; 'Demandbase Developer Portal,' offering guides and references for integrating Demandbase data and functionality; and 'Understanding the Demandbase API Suite and MCP,' which explains the platform’s API capabilities and service architecture. These resources empower users to better implement, troubleshoot, and optimize Demandbase’s data-driven products and services within their marketing and sales workflows.

title: Innovation Lab: In-Product Hub for Beta Programs and AI Innovations
content: The Innovation Lab in Demandbase is an in-product hub designed to facilitate customer access to Beta programs and AI innovations within Demandbase One. It provides customers the opportunity to discover, sign up for, and safely test new functionalities before they become generally available. This enables active customer involvement in shaping future product capabilities. The Innovation Lab follows Demandbase's formal software release stages, which ensures controlled testing environments, measurable outcomes, and tenant-level governance to maintain security and operational oversight. This approach supports experimentation without disrupting production environments and helps Demandbase gather critical usage feedback to refine innovations prior to full release.

title: Demandbase MCP: Secure Intelligent Gateway for AI Access to Tenant and Third-Party Data
content: Demandbase MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a secure, intelligent gateway that enables natural language access to both first-party Demandbase tenant data and enriched third-party B2B intelligence. This gateway powers AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code extensions, allowing them to retrieve valuable insights related to companies, contacts, engagement signals, intent data, and other account intelligence. The MCP acts as an interface layer supporting AI-driven querying and analysis, facilitating real-time AI-powered decision making in B2B marketing and sales operations. This capability extends the use of Demandbase data into conversational AI and developer tools with security and governance controls through the MCP framework.

title: Enhancements to Demandbase One for Sales Browser Extension for Faster Prospecting
content: The Demandbase One for Sales Browser Extension has been upgraded to improve prospecting speed and actionability. New features include displaying email addresses and phone numbers directly in list views, enabling sales reps to quickly access key contact information. Additionally, sales users can now see Engagement Points (formerly Engagement Minutes), a Contact Quality Score (CQS), Buying Group insights, and the New/Known contact status at a glance. The extension also supports advanced filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing efficient prioritization of prospects. Importantly, full support has been added for LinkedIn People Search and Sales Navigator People and Leads lists, resolving previous issues with unsupported view errors. This allows seamless display and export of all contacts on LinkedIn pages, vastly simplifying social prospecting workflows.

title: Terminology Update: Engagement Minutes Renamed to Engagement Points
content: Demandbase has updated its engagement metric terminology by renaming 'Engagement Minutes' to 'Engagement Points' to better reflect the way engagement is quantified across buyer journey interactions. The change clarifies that engagement measurement is not solely about the time customers spend interacting but also accounts for actions, intent signals, and meaningful interactions. This is strictly a naming change; no data, scoring methodologies, or underlying functionalities have been altered. The rebranding aims to facilitate easier communication and interpretation of engagement insights among users, emphasizing a holistic view of engagement rather than just duration.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Native Integration Enhances Buying Group Campaigns
content: Demandbase now offers a native integration with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement (formerly ExactTarget) that enables customers to leverage buying group campaigns more effectively within SFMC. This integration facilitates real-time data transfer from Demandbase into SFMC, including dynamic account scoring and precise engagement metrics. The seamless flow of fresh and actionable Demandbase data empowers marketing teams using SFMC to make smarter, faster decisions and drive more meaningful account conversations. This integration is specifically for SFMC Engagement and does not support Pardot. It transforms campaign orchestration by connecting Demandbase insights directly to SFMC's marketing automation workflows.

title: Email Agent for Demandbase One for Sales: AI-Powered Sales Email Content Creation
content: Email Agent is an AI-driven content creation feature embedded within Demandbase One for Sales designed to support SDRs, BDRs, and Account Executives in rapidly generating personalized and relevant sales emails. It analyzes real-time account and contact engagement signals such as intent data, page visits, campaign responses, and CRM activities to create contextually aligned email drafts. These drafts can be customized for product messaging and preferred tones of communication. Incorporated directly into People records, Email Agent allows representatives to create, copy, and open email drafts in their native email client seamlessly, all within their sales workflow. This integration enhances efficiency and personalizes outreach, aiming to increase engagement and conversion rates.

title: Entitlement Usage Dashboard: Track Feature Usage Against Contractual Limits
content: The Entitlement Usage Dashboard is a centralized tool available to Customer Admins and account teams that provides visibility into the consumption of purchased entitlements across the Demandbase platform. It offers insights into current usage levels and how close organizations are to reaching contractual limits for various features including Workspaces, Predictive Modeling modules, and Buying Groups. The dashboard enables proactive management of platform usage to ensure compliance with contract terms and to optimize allocation of resources within tenant accounts. This feature helps drive better governance and planning by highlighting entitlement consumption in an easy-to-access format.

title: User & System Notifications: Real-Time Updates and Management
content: Demandbase One delivers real-time notifications both within the application and via email to keep users informed about important updates and system events. These notifications can be viewed, filtered, dismissed, and managed through a dedicated interface to help users respond to actionable messages promptly. Notifications include clear messages with direct links and call-to-action buttons for immediate follow-up. Users have the ability to snooze notifications to reduce distractions if desired. Notification types cover various domains including Data Integrity alerts, enabling users to monitor and maintain data health effectively. This notification system enhances operational awareness and responsiveness for Demandbase users.

title: Demandbase One Platform Overview and Key Differentiators
content:
Demandbase One is a comprehensive account-based go-to-market (GTM) platform designed to assist B2B companies in identifying and engaging their most valuable accounts effectively. It integrates AI, data, and advertising capabilities into a single, unified platform, providing end-to-end solutions that streamline marketing and sales efforts.

Key Features include:
1. Account Intelligence: Employs AI-powered account identification and scoring systems that leverage multiple data types including intent data, technographics, and firmographics. This rigorous data analysis allows companies to accurately prioritize accounts based on buying signals and fit.
2. B2B Advertising: Provides the only true B2B Demand-Side Platform (DSP) with native capabilities, enabling precise, targeted advertising campaigns tailored for business customers.
3. Sales Intelligence: Offers real-time buying signals and engagement tracking tools for sales teams, ensuring they are equipped with actionable insights to effectively engage prospects.
4. Marketing Orchestration: Supports account-based experience (ABX) capabilities, facilitating the creation and execution of multi-channel campaigns that deliver personalized messaging across various platforms.
5. Buying Groups: Enables identification and tracking of entire buying committees within target accounts, ensuring sales and marketing efforts address all relevant stakeholders.

Competitive Advantages:
- Sole platform offering a native B2B DSP, setting it apart in the market.
- Access to the largest B2B intent data set available, enhancing predictive capabilities.
- AI-powered Agentbase technology that drives enhanced data intelligence and automation.
- Provides a unified platform solution rather than disparate point products, simplifying workflows and data integration.
- Robust integrations with leading CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot, ensuring seamless data synchronization and process alignment across marketing and sales teams.

title: Demandbase One Platform - Key Differentiators and Capabilities
content:
Demandbase One is a leading account-based go-to-market (GTM) platform specifically designed to help B2B companies identify and engage their most valuable target accounts. The platform uniquely combines artificial intelligence, rich data sets, and advanced advertising capabilities into a single, unified solution that supports multiple aspects of B2B marketing and sales execution.

Key Features include:
1. Account Intelligence: Utilizes AI-powered methods to identify and score target accounts dynamically. This feature leverages intent data, technographic profiles (technology usage data), and firmographic attributes (company size, industry, etc.) to prioritize accounts for outreach and engagement.

2. B2B Advertising: Demandbase provides the only true B2B Demand-Side Platform (DSP) with native capabilities, enabling advertisers to precisely target business audiences across channels without relying on third-party DSPs. This native DSP supports programmatic ad buying tailored to B2B business needs.

3. Sales Intelligence: Offers real-time signals about buying intent and engagement activities to sales teams, facilitating timely and contextually relevant outreach. This includes tracking of actionable engagement data to improve sales pipeline efficiency.

4. Marketing Orchestration: Facilitates Account-Based Experience (ABX) marketing by orchestrating multi-channel campaigns that align messaging and outreach across various marketing touchpoints to targeted accounts.

5. Buying Groups: Identifies and tracks entire buying committees or group decision-making units within target accounts, supporting more comprehensive and effective engagement strategies.

Competitive Advantages:
- Sole vendor offering a native B2B Demand-Side Platform, separating Demandbase from vendors requiring integration with external DSPs.
- Possesses the largest B2B intent data set available, offering unparalleled data depth and scale for account targeting.
- Powered by advanced AI technology branded as Agentbase, enhancing data intelligence and automation capabilities.
- Provides a unified platform that integrates multiple GTM functions, in contrast to competitors that offer fragmented or point solutions.
- Strong integrations with Salesforce and HubSpot CRM platforms, enabling seamless data flow and workflow integration for marketing and sales teams.

Together, these features and advantages establish Demandbase One as a comprehensive, AI-driven platform designed to optimize B2B account engagement and drive measurable revenue growth.
